goal: Production-ready Ratio customer cost and value workflows with Frank Coster

tasks.title: Persistent customer and Frank workflows
tasks.instruction: Resolve failing foundation checks without weakening or skipping assertions. Preserve independent approval, immutable ledger, tenant isolation and simulated/live separation.

tasks.title: Validate container and persistent storage operations
tasks.instruction: Exercise the local simulation containers, restart persistence and worker recovery, then implement any required fixes. Keep loopback binding and simulation-only identities.

tasks.title: Run database and ingestion acceptance
tasks.instruction: Validate existing Postgres and S3 integration in the configured disposable dev stack. Resolve reconciliation and isolation failures without changing financial semantics.

tasks.title: Connect and validate real identity and tenant permissions
tasks.requires: A chosen identity provider, dev configuration and test accounts
tasks.instruction: Implement server-verified identity and tenant mapping, sign-in/out/expiry, role boundaries and negative tenant tests; remove mock identity selection from the live path.

tasks.title: Reconcile personal-account data in dev
tasks.requires: Authorized dev provider accounts and scoped credentials
tasks.instruction: Connect authorized billing sources, reconcile control totals, test replay and failure recovery, and verify every persona against live dev data.

tasks.title: Validate live Frank inference and tool boundaries
tasks.requires: Selected model provider and a dev inference budget
tasks.instruction: Implement grounded multi-turn conversations, tool allowlists, inference metering, timeouts and adversarial evaluations. Human verification and consequential-action approvals remain mandatory.

tasks.title: Provision and verify production operating controls
tasks.requires: Selected deployment target and authorized infrastructure access
tasks.instruction: Implement IaC, real secrets management, TLS, tenant isolation, durable HA storage, distributed jobs, monitoring, backup retention and restore drills. Measure load, recovery and cost targets.

tasks.title: Complete release acceptance and publication
tasks.requires: Prior gates green, customer acceptance and explicit publication approval
tasks.instruction: Verify every persona end to end with real auth/data; review accessibility, evidence correctness and security. Publish only after explicit authorization. Never mark release complete from simulation tests.
